title: OF ALL IN EARTH OR HEAVEN290
author: Nathan A. Aldersley (1826-1899)
stanzas: Of all in earth or Heaven, The dearest name to me, Is the matchless Name of Jesus, The The Christ of Calvary.
I cannot help but love Him, And tell His love to me; For He became my ransom, The Christ of Calvary
I could not live without Him. His love is life to me; My blood-bought life I give Him, The christ of Calvary
chorus: The Christ of Calvary, The dearest name to me, Is the matchless Name of Jesus, The christ of Calvary
